name: DeleteColumnFromDataTableNode
label: Delete Column From Data Table
description: Deletes a data table column at the specified column index or column name.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SpecifyColumnWith
fields.label: Specify Column With
fields.description: Specifies whether to delete the column by name or index.

fields.name: ColumnName
fields.label: Column Name
fields.description: The name of the column to delete (required if 'Specify Column With' is 'Name').

fields.name: ColumnIndex
fields.label: Column Index
fields.description: The zero-based index of the column to delete (required if 'Specify Column With' is 'Index').

fields.name: ModifiedDataTable
fields.label: Modified Data Table
fields.description: Returns the updated data table after the column is deleted.
